title: MacOS Ready
description: The ultimate optimization modpack built for M-Series Macs.
body:
***I highly recommend using [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/download/macos/) or [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app), since they have the native ARM64 build of Minecraft. The game will run _**much**_ better.***

**Are you not satisfied with the performance of Minecraft on your Mac? Well, then this modpack is for you!**

## Why download?
If you've ever played Java Edition without mods, you probably know the pain of having low FPS and stutters. Well, this modpack is made to fix that! It includes all kinds of mods, from optimization to quality of life, plus it doesn't affect the vanilla gameplay!

Here are some of the features:

### Performance

This modpack includes some _essential_ optimization mods like Sodium and Lithium.
Also, there are mods to optimize the chunk gen, like **C2ME** and **fast noise**.
We also added Metallum, which is an optimization mod specifically for Macs.

### Native Renderer
![Native Metal Performance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75e0d3e4520c9415ec1215a10440a69b0ccebed.png)
We sacrificed shaders for **Metallum**. This mod allows Minecraft to use Apple's native Metal renderer, so it runs MUCH better.

### Battery saving
**Dynamic FPS** will help you save battery when AFK or doing anything other than Minecraft.

### Exploration
This modpack features **Geophilic**, which upgrades already existing biomes!

### LAN Worlds
We assume your friends are not on the same WiFi as you, so **e4mc** is included!
Instead of opening the world to LAN, it generates an IP adress your friends can join!

### Other Quality of Life mods
You know that mod that shows what block you're looking at at the top of the screen?
Yeah, that's **Jade**, and it's included! Of course there are more.

### Compatibility
Since version 1.0.1, this modpack is only compatible on M-Series (MacBook Neo included) Macs, because of Metallum.
